projectDescription: A tiny macOS menu bar app built with Electron that shows local listening processes by folder, PID, and port — letting you open localhost or kill services in one click.
keyFeatures: Lives in the macOS menu bar showing a live process count (🐀 N)
Lists local TCP LISTEN processes with PID, working-directory folder name, and ports
Prioritises processes tied to real project folders over system processes
One-click to open http://localhost:<port> in the default browser
One-click kill with SIGTERM → SIGKILL fallback
Auto-refresh every 2.5 seconds in the popup and every 4 seconds in the tray count
Automatic background update checks via GitHub Releases (electron-updater)
Manual update check from the right-click tray menu
publicApiSurface: snitchApi.listProcesses() — IPC process:list — returns array of {pid, comm, args, cwd, endpoints, ports}
snitchApi.killProcess(pid) — IPC process:kill — sends SIGTERM then SIGKILL fallback
snitchApi.openUrl(url) — IPC url:open — opens a validated http://localhost:<port> URL externally
snitchApi.setWindowHeight(height) — IPC window:set-height — resizes the popup window within min/max bounds
npm start — launch in development mode with electron .
npm run dist:mac:arm64 — build distributable DMG + ZIP for Apple Silicon
npm run desktop:install — build and copy Snitch.app to ~/Desktop
